portrait.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw FIRST native 8x pose reference as MICA the original female pangolin from SECOND concept sheet; THIRD and FOURTH approved pixel-art style anchors. New drawing, no recolour, no Sonic quills or blue hedgehog features. Rounded overlapping jade leaf-scale hood, long cream snout, small round coral inner ears, bright brown eyes/lashes, white gloves, coral hiking boots. Clean chunky 16-bit pixel clusters with strong dark ink and jade highlights. Transparent canvas, no padding, no checkerboard, no text. Final native 32x40 S3K data-select full-body portrait. Face LEFT, raised index-finger glove on LEFT as native pose, other hand on hip at RIGHT. Keep body posture, feet positions and full-body framing exactly. Rounded scaled tail behind, not projecting beyond native bounds. Match pose composition first reference precisely, character identity second reference.
